description: Prove the test/verify stage end-to-end on the sample repos: the regression guard (existing tests still pass after a change), new-test generation for the change, and the legacy no-tests path (characterization tests generated before modifying). Deliver a runnable verification harness that demonstrates the full ingest->...->apply loop on samples/pyapp and the characterization path on samples/legacy_pyapp, so the Phase-1 milestone is objectively provable without a live Copilot session.
steps: Implement .apia/scripts/verify.py: a stack-aware harness that, given a repo path and the adapter, (a) runs the existing test suite and records the baseline (pass/fail counts), (b) after a change is present, re-runs existing tests to prove no regression, and (c) runs newly added tests. It reports a compact machine-readable summary (JSON) and a human summary. It must call only the adapter's test commands locally (NO LLM calls).

Scripted proof for samples/pyapp (regression + new test): add a concrete worked example under samples/pyapp demonstrating a small feature change (e.g. add a new function + modify an existing one) WITH a new test for the new behavior, and show verify.py reporting existing tests still green AND the new test green. Keep the change in a clearly labeled example (e.g. a committed example diff or an example test file) so it is reproducible.

Scripted proof for samples/legacy_pyapp (characterization path): implement/trigger characterization-test generation that pins the CURRENT behavior of a legacy module BEFORE any modification (the tests assert existing outputs for representative inputs). Add these generated characterization tests under samples/legacy_pyapp/tests/, then demonstrate a safe modification and show verify.py proving the characterization tests still pass (behavior preserved) plus a new test for the added behavior.
Wire the test-authoring skill (FEAT-003) to reference verify.py and the adapter so the human-facing loop and the scriptable harness use the same commands.

Add an end-to-end pytest (e.g. .apia/scripts/tests/test_e2e_loop.py) that exercises: ingest(samples/pyapp) -> knowledge artifacts exist -> verify.py baseline green -> apply the example change -> verify.py reports no regression + new test green; and ingest(samples/legacy_pyapp) -> characterization tests generated and green -> safe change -> characterization + new tests green. This test IS the objective Phase-1 proof.
Document in docs/PHASE-1-TASKS.md (or a new docs/PROOF.md) exactly how to run the end-to-end proof and what each step demonstrates relative to the five-stage loop.
acceptance_criteria: .apia/scripts/verify.py runs existing + new tests via the stack adapter and emits a JSON + human summary, with no LLM/network calls.
samples/pyapp has a reproducible worked change showing existing tests stay green AND a new test for the new behavior passes.

samples/legacy_pyapp has generated characterization tests pinning current behavior, and after a safe change those characterization tests still pass plus a new test passes (legacy no-tests path proven).
An end-to-end pytest ties ingest -> verify -> apply across both samples and passes.
docs/PROOF.md (or an added section) documents how to run and interpret the end-to-end proof against the five-stage loop.
verification: Run `python3 -m pytest .apia/scripts/tests -q` (including the e2e test) and confirm all pass.
Run `python3 .apia/scripts/verify.py samples/pyapp` and confirm the summary reports existing tests green and new tests green.
Run `python3 .apia/scripts/verify.py samples/legacy_pyapp` and confirm characterization + new tests green.
Run `grep -rniE 'openai|anthropic|chat/completions|requests\.' .apia/scripts/verify.py` and confirm no external LLM/network calls.
review_fix_findings: Review iteration 1 (addressing .tasks/2026-10-12-054254-review.md, 8 issues). (1) Regression phase now proves a real before/after delta: verify.py --baseline-only persists the pre-change existing-suite counts + collected pytest node set to <repo>/.apia-baseline.json (via save_baseline/load_baseline), and a later (post-change) regression phase compares against it with compare_to_baseline(), flagging a regression when a pre-change passing test now fails, when fewer existing tests pass, or when a pre-change node disappeared. The regression phase fails and summary.ok=False on a true regression. (2) The baseline/regression phases now EXCLUDE the --new-tests target (pytest --ignore + --deselect) so 'existing tests' is genuinely the pre-change suite; pyapp baseline is now 4 (was 7), legacy baseline 9 (was 13). (3) _test_command() now raises StubAdapterError for a stub adapter (null test_command) instead of defaulting to 'python -m pytest'; the CLI maps it to parser.error. All three Phase-1 stubs (cpp/csharp/groovy) are refused. (4) ingest._parse_pyproject() rewritten to track the active [table] header and handle MULTI-LINE arrays for both [project].dependencies and every key under [project.optional-dependencies]; single-line form still works and non-dependency array keys (classifiers, pythonpath, testpaths, etc.) are never collected. (5) Reconciled the JetBrains/Agent-Skills matrix cell: both ARCHITECTURE.md and PORTABILITY.md now say 'No' (was 'Emerging' in both while PORTABILITY's caveats said unsupported); a test asserts the two matrices agree. (6) The legacy zero-tests trigger is now exercised: detect_no_tests()/verify() run against a tmp copy of legacy_pyapp with tests/ removed and assert had_no_tests_before fires; also hardened detection to recognize pytest's 'no tests collected'/'no tests ran' phrasings (not only 'collected 0 items'), since testpaths-fallback prints a different string. python.yml doc updated accordingly. (7) MCP: ARCHITECTURE.md now states explicitly that ALL concrete MCP data-source wiring is DEFERRED to Phase 2 (open question #4 resolved); web/fetch on apia-planner is the only live, data-only external path in Phase 1. (8) Removed the unreachable elif-dead-branch in discover_tests (conftest.py handling kept and tested); tightened apia-ingest.prompt.md so it no longer grants edit/files+run/terminal to the read-only apia-planner (now search/* + web/fetch, matching the agent), with a test asserting the prompt grants no edit/terminal. Added .apia/scripts/tests/test_review_fixes.py (16 tests) covering issues 1-8. Full suite: .venv/bin/python -m pytest .apia/scripts/tests -q -> 42 passed; samples/pyapp 7 passed, samples/legacy_pyapp 13 passed; verify.py ALL GREEN on both samples. No-external-LLM guard tests still pass; scripts remain stdlib + optional PyYAML, zero network.
findings: Implemented .apia/scripts/verify.py: a pure off-model, stack-aware harness that reads .apia/adapters/python.yml and runs three phases via the adapter's local test_command only (baseline existing tests, regression re-run, and a NEW-tests phase from --new-tests), emitting a human summary plus optional --json. It rewrites the adapter's 'python -m pytest' to sys.executable so the harness and tests share one env, and uses no_tests_detection to flag the legacy case. ZERO network/LLM imports (only mentions are prohibiting prose in the docstring; grep check passes). Worked example on samples/pyapp: added calc.multiply (new) and made divide's error message descriptive while preserving ZeroDivisionError (existing tests stay green); added tests/test_multiply.py (3 tests). Legacy path on samples/legacy_pyapp: added pyproject.toml (pythonpath=['.'], testpaths=['tests']) so the package is importable when pytest rootdir is that dir; generated tests/test_inventory_characterization.py (9 tests) pinning CURRENT behavior of inventory.py (including the no-validation quirk where negative percent increases price); made a safe additive change (new reorder_quantity, no existing function touched) with tests/test_reorder.py (4 tests). Wired apia-test-authoring SKILL.md to reference verify.py and docs/PROOF.md. Added .apia/scripts/tests/test_e2e_loop.py (3 e2e tests) using subprocess-with-cwd via verify.verify so each sample's own pyproject pythonpath applies regardless of outer rootdir. Documented the full run + five-stage mapping in docs/PROOF.md. NOTE: FEAT-004 intentionally changes the sample repos, so two FEAT-002 tests that hard-coded the old sample state were updated: test_pyapp_test_inventory_lists_tests (4 -> 7 tests, now also expects test_multiply.py) and the legacy test renamed test_legacy_has_characterization_tests (0 -> >=1 tests, expects the generated characterization + reorder tests). Verified these two passed on the base state via git stash before updating. Full suite: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest .apia/scripts/tests -q` -> 25 passed. verify.py green on both samples.
